text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, when I visited the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's not just the care products, 
but how you wash and dry it that matters.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. How you dry it, especially, makes 
a massive difference to your styling the 
next day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A professional's perspective really is 
different. I'm glad I asked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide was talking with Gold City. 
It seems she's asking for advice regarding 
her hair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I asked City-kun about hair care, 
since she's a professional model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
TBH, I personally don't think you need to 
worry that much about it, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because your hair is so pretty, Senpai. 
It's so smooth and wavy—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —No, that's not it, City.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is barely maintained through 
relentless daily effort, you see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Neglect its care for even a single day, 
and it'll instantly turn into a wild mess 
like a rampaging dragon.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, the Rampaging Dragon...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right. If you're fretting over it 
that much, how about I introduce you to my 
hair salon?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A lot of places have been putting extra 
care into body conditioning lately, so I 
hope this helps even a little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? That really helps.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: First of all, this is completely organic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I heard their hair treatments in 
particular are great. It's close by, too, 
so it should be easy to visit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, being able to take care of it nearby 
is a relief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And over here is a popular head spa. Their 
slogan is "Dramatic evolution, starting 
from the scalp"—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What, a dramatic evolution...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Apparently it's pretty legit. They say 
cleaning your scalp properly can even 
change your hair texture.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hair texture changes...!? Then even these 
wavy curls will turn straight before my 
very eyes...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Ah... oh no.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they relocated. ...To 
Kansai.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What... !?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Kansai is just too far, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it is a 'dramatic evolution,' 
right...? It's worth a shot...!"
choice_data_list: Are you actually planning on going!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I know! I know what you want to 
say...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still, hearing the words 'dramatic 
evolution'... how could I possibly keep 
quiet...?!"
choice_data_list: Maybe we should keep it local...

Well, if it's on the way during a trip to 
Kansai...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is indeed a rational decision...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However... however...! After we went 
through all the trouble of getting useful 
info...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... hey, there's a really good head spa 
nearby too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Like here, and around here. It's totally 
looking good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, I tried to 
persuade Biwa Hayahide together with Gold 
City.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, there was that option...!! 
Excellent suggestion, Trainer-kun!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then whenever there's a race at Hanshin 
Racecourse, we should definitely drop by!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you... serious?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Improvement starting from the 
scalp! A dramatic evolution!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Both in the race and against this raging 
dragon, I will definitely win...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Biwa Hayahide gathered 
materials on Hanshin Racecourse and head 
spas, building up her knowledge for the 
coming day.
